Local Design Lab · lock gate · cards + detail experiences

What “View details” actually opens

Billing's Current Period now reconciles on screen, in the platform's own financial grammar. Both detail experiences are designed, on the expand pattern Household and Children already use. And the platform caps an expanded card body at 360px — which is a decision you need to make.

Billing summary reconciles 1023 × 353

The correction is semantic, not cosmetic. In CHARGE_CATEGORIES, subsidy_offset is a charge category — not a payment. So subsidy reduces family responsibility, while payments, a separate object (payments + payment_allocations), reduce balance. The zone therefore carries two totals, both labelled, never one:

StepSourceThis period
Gross chargestuition · deposit · consumable_fee · late_pickup · one_time · fee$1,925
− Discounts & creditsdiscount · credit · adjustment−$185
− Fundingsubsidy_offset−$600
= Family responsibilitythe charge stack, status = posted$1,140
− Payments receivedpayment_allocations against those charges−$925
= Current balance$215
Past due ⊆ balancethe portion whose due_date has passed$215

Recent Ledger is gone from the summary; one quiet history line replaces it. Manage payers, methods, autopay and the split are one Manage payment destination, not three links.

Billing detail expanded density 1023 × 677

The same card at density="expanded" — the centered Focus Card with a depth scrim that Household, Children and the real BillingPreviewCard already use. Not a separate Billing product.

The ledger takes a full-width band beneath the three columns, because a real table needs room: Date / Type / Description / Amount / Status / Source, with the five filters. No running balance column — ledger_transactions provides no authoritative running balance, and computing one in the card would invent an ordering the backend does not guarantee. The card says so on its own surface rather than quietly omitting it.

Health detail expanded density 1023 × 941

Three boundaries the layout enforces, rather than merely respecting:

  1. 1Medication authorization is a requirement, not a medication field. It appears on the record as a pointer, labelled “requirement, not a field”, and its truth resolves against a document in Requirements. The medication fact stays true whether or not the authorization exists.
  2. 2Document existence is never a health boolean. Documents shows the document, its version and status; Requirements resolves against it.
  3. 3Emergency contacts are projected from person.contact_role.emergency_contacts. Health never owns a contact, and the surface says so.

Nothing is a live input. Read, then Add or Edit opens a focused command: understand → choose → focused command → validate → save. Provenance reuses the lineage the platform already records — parent reported, document extraction, operator confirmed.

G1 · a platform constraint you need to decide

.alloy-os-ucard--expanded .alloy-os-ucard__body is max-height: min(360px, 45vh); overflow-y: auto. Both detail surfaces are 440–950px of content in a 360px scroll window. Either the details accept a scrolling panel, or expanded density needs a taller host. This is a platform decision, not a card decision, and it affects Household and Children equally. The lab renders each detail twice — at true runtime height, and unclipped behind a lab-only class so the whole design can be read.

Canonical health model — one entity, not three

One person_health_facts with a fact_kind discriminator (allergy | condition | medication), polymorphic by subject_entity_type/subject_entity_id exactly as documents already is. The card, the requirement evaluator and the packet planner all want one list for a child; three tables would triple the resolver, provider, proposal adapter and RLS surface for three shapes that share everything except the payload. A medication references the allergy it treats by self-reference — across three tables that needs a polymorphic join.

It is not a childcare subsystem. Nothing in the shape names a program, an age group, a jurisdiction or an industry, and the payload schema per kind is org-configurable exactly as document_field_definitions is per doc_type.

Versioning is supersede, never delete. A correction writes a new row with supersedes_id and closes the old one's effective_to; a resolution just closes it. Safety information that silently disappears is the failure mode this avoids — and it mirrors the original | correction | reversal semantics attendance already uses, so the platform keeps one mental model.

Trust / Enrollment handoff — four rules

  1. 1Trust never writes health truth directly. It emits a proposal; the health capability performs the write. A proposal with status: "unsupported" — exactly what a health collection produces today via unknown_provider / unsupported_item_entity — must fail loudly, never partially apply.
  2. 2Health never re-interprets. If a document says “peanut allergy, severe”, the severity arrived decided. Health stores source_kind + source_ref and does not second-guess.
  3. 3Requirements are never stored as satisfied. Satisfaction is evaluated at read time against the pinned revision. Storing it creates a second truth that drifts.
  4. 4The card computes nothing. It projects what exists and what applies.
